task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Prepare and draft emergency public-health decrees — quarantine protocols, physician coordination, resource allocation, and the agenda for the assembly's ratification vote
Convene to ratify emergency funding, quarantine authority, and any extraordinary magistracies required to combat the epidemic
Execute the civil response — enforce quarantines, distribute supplies and grain, oversee burials and sanitation, coordinate with temples and physicians, and maintain public order
